newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Q1 overseas investment approvals fall.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Q1 overseas investment approvals fall.

text.p: Approvals given to South Korean companies for overseas direct investment totalled $1.25 billion in the first quarter of this year, down from $1.59 billion a year earlier, the central Bank of Korea said on Thursday.
The bank said in a statement China was the top destination for South Korean investment, with approvals for investment there at $199.5 million, or 15.9 percent of the total amount.
The United States came next, with approvals totalling $163.7 million, or 13.1 percent of the total.
Approvals for investment in Asia excluding the Middle East totalled $624.1 million, accounting for 49.9 percent of the total, the statement said.
Actual investment implemented during the three-month period also fell to $1.01 billion from $1.64 billion in the same period of 1996, it added.
The statement did not provide additional information.
